hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */node_modules/*) exit 0 ;; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; case "$f" in *.js|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.jsx|*.ts|*.mts|*.cts|*.tsx) out=$(node_modules/.bin/oxlint --type-aware -f unix "$f" 2>&1) || { printf 'oxlint reported problems in %s. Fix them:\n%s\n' "$f" "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0
